title: Route and Deliver Through BOS Divisions

div6_research.summary: Researched and profiled 6 Kazakhstan payments market competitors with verifiable data and sourced citations
div6_research.routingComment: Div6 conducted external market research across 6 competitors using multiple sources per profile (2-4 each). Research artifacts include competitor names, scale metrics, relevance assessment, and risk factors. All data sourced from public filings, company websites, and market research.

div5_validation.summary: Produced aipay.kz competitive positioning analysis covering 6 competitors, 5 value gaps, 4 underserved niches, 5 ranked threats, and 5 actionable insights
div5_validation.routingComment: Div5 validated Div6 research against live market data and aipay.kz product positioning. Verified competitor data accuracy against live website (aipay.kz/en). Produced competitive matrix with evidence-based threat severity ratings. Validated that all 6 T01 competitors appear in positioning analysis with consistent data.

div2_planning.summary: Synthesized T01 competitor research and T02 positioning analysis into a 1900-word strategic recommendations report with 5 actionable recommendations for AiPay.kz founder
div2_planning.routingComment: Div2 synthesized Div6 research and Div5 validation into actionable strategic recommendations. Report structured for startup founder audience: concise, opinionated, actionable with clear owner and next step per recommendation. 5 recommendations covering integration moats, multi-platform verification, recurring payments niche, Digital Tenge integration, and analytics retention.

div1_routing.summary: Routing chain verified; Paperclip mission issue creation blocked by authentication failure
div1_routing.routingComment: Div1 verified the complete routing chain from Div6 research through Div5 validation to Div2 planning. All division outputs validated as complete and consistent. Paperclip mission issue creation attempted but blocked by authentication failure on all methods: API key (401 Unauthorized), session login (invalid credentials), registration (user already exists).

routingValidation.crossDivisionConsistency: All 6 competitors flow consistently from T01 through T02 to T03
routingValidation.reportCompleteness: 1900 words, all 6 sections, 5 recommendations with owner/next-step/success-metric

paperclipBlocker.knownIssue: MEM295 and MEM300 document persistent Paperclip auth failure
paperclipBlocker.resolution: Requires fresh credentials from Paperclip administrator
